entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an additional 2 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Treacherous Allure
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enchanting Presence
entries: You always have the {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot, and you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Inevitable Betrayal
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures with the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
entries: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren't already adding it to the damage.

name: Tyro of the Gauntlet
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Stand as One
entries: When an ally within 5 feet of you is subjected to an effect that would push or pull it, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to prevent that ally from being pushed or pulled. To receive this benefit, the ally can't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Vigilant
entries: When you take the {@action Ready|XPHB} action, the next attack roll made against you has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} before the start of your next turn.

name: Unarmed Fighting
entries: When you hit with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to {@damage 1d6} plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. If you aren't holding any weapons or a {@item Shield|XPHB} when you make the attack roll, the {@dice d6} becomes a {@dice d8}.
At the start of each of your turns, you can deal {@damage 1d4} Bludgeoning damage to one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you.

name: Vampire Hunter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Adroit Escape
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks to escape from nonmagical restraints or the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Vitality Ward
entries: When you take Necrotic damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to mitigate the damage. Roll a number of d6s equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and add them together. Reduce the Necrotic damage you take by this total. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Vampire Touched
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Vampire Magic
entries: Choose one level 1 spell from the Enchantment or Illusion school of magic. You always have that spell and the {@spell Spider Climb|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot, but when you cast {@spell Spider Climb|XPHB} this way, you must target yourself, and you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can cast each spell in this way again. You can also cast either spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spells is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Vampire's Plaything
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Decanting
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can create one {@item Potion of Healing|XDMG} or an {@item Antitoxin|XPHB}, as long as you have an empty {@item vial|XPHB} or {@item flask|XPHB}. These liquids evaporate when you finish another {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Timely Retreat
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action or the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you recover all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vampiric Connection
entries: The DM determines the fate of your former vampire master. While you and your former vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with you telepathically, and you can choose to allow the vampire to perceive through your senses.

name: Vampiric Exultation
entries: As an action, you can transform the lower half of your body into an inky black vapor, allowing you to float through the air. While transformed, you have a flying speed of 30 feet. You can maintain this form for up to 10 minutes. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Vigor of the Hill Giant

feat: strike of the giants|BGG|strike of the giants (hill strike)

entries: You've manifested the resilience emblematic of hill giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Bulwark
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that would move you at least 5 feet or give you the prone condition, you can use your reaction to steady yourself. You aren't moved and don't have the prone condition.

items.name: Iron Stomach
entries: Whenever you eat food as part of a short rest and spend one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points, you regain additional hit points equal to your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus.

name: War Caster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Concentration
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

entries.name: Reactive Spell
entries: When a creature provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} from you by leaving your reach, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cast a spell at the creature rather than making an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}. The spell must have a casting time of one action and must target only that creature.

entries.name: Somatic Components
entries: You can perform the Somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a {@item Shield|XPHB} in one or both hands.

name: Watchers
entries: Something unnatural is always watching you, taking the form of scurrying vermin and other eerie creatures. You gain the following features.

entries.name: Borrowed Eyes
entries: You always have the {@spell Beast Sense|XPHB} and {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spells prepared. You can cast each spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

entries.name: Heightened Suspicion
entries: Whenever you take the {@action Search|XPHB} action, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to any ability check made as part of that action.

entries.name: Incessant Watchers
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws made against the {@spell Scrying|XPHB} spell.

In addition, immediately after you make a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} and roll a 1 on the {@dice d20}, paranoia threatens to overwhelm you. Make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} for 1 minute. You can repeat the save at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect early on a success.

images.title: The Watchers Dark Gift might manifest as anything from simple vermin to alien beings—like the Staring Cats of Uldun-Dar

name: Weapon Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mastery Property
entries: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery property of one kind of Simple or Martial weapon of your choice, provided you have proficiency with it. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can change the kind of weapon to another eligible kind.

name: Wood Elf Magic
entries: You learn the magic of the primeval woods, which are revered and protected by your people. You learn one druid cantrip of your choice. You also learn the {@spell longstrider} and {@spell pass without trace} spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

name: Zhentarim Ruffian
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Exploit Opening
entries: When you roll damage for an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}, you can roll the damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

entries.name: Family First
entries: If you have {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} when you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you can expend it to give yourself and your allies {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on that {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll.

name: Zhentarim Tactics
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Retaliate
entries: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can make an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} against that creature.

entries.name: Versatile Merc
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, choose a skill in which you have proficiency. You have {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in that skill until you finish your next {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Blackpowder Expert
entries: You are well-versed in the use of Blackpowder weapons and wield them with deadly efficiency. You gain the following benefits:

items: You ignore the loading property of Blackpowder weapons with which you are proficient.
Whenever a hostile creature moves within 10 feet of you, and you did not move on your last turn, you can use a reaction to make a ranged weapon attack against that creature.

name: Nocturnal
entries: Due to extensive exposure to the dark, and possible supernatural abilities, you have an unmatched ability to fight adversaries in the dark. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain Darkvision with a radius of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, then the radius of your darkvision increases by 30 feet, to a maximum of 120 feet.
You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in dim light or nonmagical darkness.

name: Scatter Weapon Master
entries: Through many hours spent using these destructive weapons, whether on the training grounds or setting hag huts ablaze, you have gained immense experience with scatter weapons and gain the following benefits:

items: Critical hits double the damage dealt by the Scatter property on a failed save.
When making an attack with a weapon with the Scatter property, you may choose any number of targets to gain advantage on saving throws caused by your attack.
You ignore the Loading quality of Scatter weapons with which you are proficient.

name: Weaver of Maledictions

prerequisite.other: The ability to cast at least one spell

entries: You have learned how to use effigy dolls when cursing your targets. These dolls take 8 hours to create and can only be used on the target that the effigy was created to resemble. Only you can benefit from dolls you have created. When you use an effigy doll you gain the following benefits:

items: The target of the curse has disadvantage on their initial saving throw.
The target of your curse does not know that you tried to curse them upon a successful save against being cursed.

name: Adroit Crafter

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency in a skill or tool

entries: You've trained in crafting items using a skill or tool that you're proficient with, and the steps in crafting have become second nature to you. You gain the following benefits:

items: The time it takes to create an item using your proficient skills or tools is halved.
If you fail to successfully craft the item and would lose the components, you retain the components instead.

name: Careful Crafter

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency in a skill or tool

entries: You've trained in crafting items using a skill or tool that you're proficient with, and your creations are known for being well made and reliable. You gain the following benefits:

items: You make all ability checks for crafting with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.
Anyone assisting you in crafting an item gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on their ability checks for crafting.
If you fail to successfully craft the item, the amount of time it took to complete the process is halved.

name: Advanced Weapon Proficiency (FS)
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Weapon Proficiency
entries: You have proficiency with {@filter Advanced weapons|items|type=advanced weapon}, and your training allows you to use the mastery properties of those weapons.

name: Advanced Weapon Proficiency (G)
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Weapon Proficiency
entries: You have proficiency with {@filter Advanced weapons|items|type=advanced weapon}, and your training allows you to use the mastery properties of those weapons.

name: Blackpowder Pistol Expert
entries: You have become practiced with the use of {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24|Blackpowder Pistols}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deadeye
entries: Attacking at long range doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls with a {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24}.

entries.name: Quick Load
entries: You ignore {@itemProperty LD|XPHB|Loading} of the {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24}.

entries.name: Trick Shot
entries: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you moves, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a ranged attack with a {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24} against that creature.

name: Blood Hound
entries: Your senses are heightened beyond those of most folk. Whether these senses were strengthened through training or the loss of other senses, or they simply matured as you did, you are a master of finding those whom you seek. You  gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Motion Sensor
entries: Whenever a creature that is Small or larger moves within 10 feet of you while you do not have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, you immediately become aware of its presence.

entries.name: No Hiding
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sound or smell.

name: Boon of Magic Resistance
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Heroic Resistance
entries: If you fail a saving throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Boon of Perfect Flight
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Flying
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 40 feet and can hover.

entries.name: Graceful Fall
entries: If you fall more than 5 feet, your rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until you land.

name: Boon of Shadowsteel Mastery
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Strange Bedfellows
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Friendless|GrimHollowPG24|Friendless Transformation Flaw}.

name: Boon of the Archlich
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Vessel of Vitality
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, if your {@optfeature Soul Vessel|GrimHollowPG24} is not charged, it gains a soul and becomes charged.

name: Boon of the Ascended Vampire
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inured to Sunlight
entries: You are no longer affected by sunlight.

name: Boon of the Earthly Tether
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Persistent Haunter
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Fraying Reality|GrimHollowPG24|Fraying Reality Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Specter Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=spec:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elder Fey
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fey Bulwark
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Weakened Constitution|GrimHollowPG24|Weakened Constitution Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Fey Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=f:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

entries.name: Free Agent
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Pull of the Netherworld|GrimHollowPG24|Pull of the Netherworld Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Fiend Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=fi:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elder Horror
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Stabilizing Form
entries: When you roll a 25 or lower on the {@table Unstable Form|GrimHollowPG24|Unstable Form table}, you can choose to roll again. You must use the new result. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Aberrant Horror Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=ah:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elemental Temperance
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Controlled Chaos
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Primordial Chaos|GrimHollowPG24|Primordial Chaos Transformation Flaw}.

name: Boon of the High Seraph
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Absolution
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Seraph Corruption|GrimHollowPG24|Seraph Corruption Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Seraph Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=ser:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Wilds
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Apex Predator
entries: When you enter your Hybrid Form, you gain 25 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. At the end of each of your turns while in Hybrid Form, if you have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. While you are in your Hybrid Form and have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

name: Close Combat Artillerist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Firing in Melee
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

entries.name: Point Blank
entries: When you hit a creature that is within 5 feet of you with a ranged attack, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

name: Convincing Inquisitor
entries: You know how to spot a liar, and you can get people to see your way, whether through charm, reasonable arguments, or force of will. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Charming Presence
entries: When you take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action, you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on checks to influence {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creatures, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks to influence {@variantrule Indifferent [Attitude]|XPHB|Indifferent} creatures.

entries.name: Multiple Paths
entries: You can use any ability modifier when you take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action to make an {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} or  {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} check.

entries.name: Zealous Insight
entries: When you succeed on a {@action Search|XPHB} action's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check to detect lies or evasive answers, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls involving combat against that creature for 1 hour.

name: Deathbound
entries: You have seen death many times, up close and personal, and sometimes at your own hand. These experiences have affected you deeply, teaching you about life and death. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: One Last Breath
entries: If you have two {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB} failures, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws} until you are no longer at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Recuperation
entries: When you spend a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} to recover {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} twice and use the higher roll.

name: Dual Shot
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dual Shot
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn and attack with a bow or crossbow, you can make one extra attack as part of the same action against a creature that is within 10 feet of the original target that is within the weapon's range. If you do so, both attacks are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

name: Expanded Grip
entries: Your natural ability with larger weapons lets you use them in a way others can't. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: One-Handed Grip
entries: When you use a {@itemProperty V|XPHB|Versatile} weapon with one hand, the weapon deals the damage in parentheses when used to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Zealous Grasp
entries: If an effect forces you to drop what you are holding, you can make a DC 15 Strength saving throw to maintain your grip. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a saving throw to maintain your grip, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the saving throw.

name: Flurry
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Quick Strike
entries: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack roll with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the roll, you can forgo {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on that attack roll. After resolving that attack, you can then make another attack with the same weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} against a different creature. The new target must be within 5 feet of the first target and within the weapon's reach.

name: Fortune of the Thaumaturge
entries: Your connection to the Thaumaturge puts you in touch with forces outside mortal understanding, making others think you were born under a fortunate moon. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fortune's Fortitude
entries: When you fail a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can expend and roll one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}, adding that number to your result. You can do this only once per {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses of this ability when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Fortune of the Unknown
entries: When using the Fortune's Fortitude benefit, if you roll the highest or lowest number on the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}, you regain that {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}. It still counts as a use of Fortune's Fortitude.

name: Free Sword Mercenary's Will
entries: Your training with the Company of Free Swords has given you an increased stamina and an attitude that make you less likely to succumb to hardships. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hold the Ground
entries: When you are moved without using your movement by a creature, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the distance you are moved by up to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Resolute
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws that would apply a condition.

name: Hulking Figure
entries: Either from extensive training or a natural build, you have a broad and formidable size for your species. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Brutal
entries: Once per turn, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Bludgeoning damage to a target you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

entries.name: Intimidating
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Performance|XPHB}, or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, you can also add your Strength modifier to the roll.

entries.name: Powerful
entries: You count as one size larger (to a maximum size of Large) when determining your carrying capacity.

name: Insightful Collector
entries: Your expeditions, transactions, and mercantile activities on behalf of the Augustine Trading Company have put you in contact with collectors of historical artifacts, relics, and tomes. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Object Intuition
entries: You can take a {@action Study|XPHB} action to examine one magical object and learn its properties and how to use it without attuning to it or taking a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} in physical contact with it, but you don't learn any curse the item might bear. There is a cumulative 5% chance for every rarity above Common that you misidentify the nature and the power of the object.

entries.name: Rare Find
entries: You begin play in possession of a Common magic item. Work with your GM to decide on which object fits your character and the campaign.

name: Iron Gut
entries: You can eat like a hill giant and drink like a fish. Years of punishing your stomach and liver have led to a powerful fortitude. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inured to Poison
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Everything Looks Delicious
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks to forage for food.

entries.name: Quick to Recover
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, roll the die and add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll's total. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Lightning Caster
entries: Your rapid-fire style of casting cantrips allows you to weave magic with uncanny speed. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dual Target
entries: When you cast a cantrip with a casting time of an action that targets a single creature, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to target a second creature within the cantrip's range.

entries.name: Immediate Response
entries: When you cast a spell as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, that spell doesn't expend a spell slot. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Medician of the Morbus Doctore
entries: You are a master of the medical sciences because of your association with a medical institute. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Adept Medic
entries: When you use the Blood and Bone benefit of the Triage Expert feat, the creature can spend up to three {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} instead of one.

entries.name: Battle Surgeon
entries: When you use the Blood and Bone benefit of the Triage Expert feat, the creature can spend three {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} to end one of the following conditions on itself instead of regaining {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, or {@condition Stunned|XPHB}.
Alternatively, you can cure one {@variantrule Grievous Wounds|GrimHollowCG24|Grievous Wound} affecting the creature.

name: Mobile Combatant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Slippery
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet and {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} against you until the end of your turn.

name: Nimble Physique
entries: You are small and thin for your species. You have a mysterious and consistent ability to avoid danger. You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Dodgy
entries: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB}, you can take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

items.name: Slippery
entries: While you are {@condition Grappled|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, your attacks don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} and attacks against you don't have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

name: Opportunist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Exploit Weakness
entries: Whenever you make an attack as part of a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you gain a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

name: Prone Defense
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Defensive
entries: When you have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. {@action Attack|XPHB} rolls against you don't have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} because of the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Hop Up
entries: When you have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of movement.

name: Resolution of the Syndicate
entries: Membership in the Ebon Syndicate provides perks—one of which is the motivation that comes with the understanding that the Syndicate kills those who fail too often. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Quick Strike
entries: On your first turn after an {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll, add {@dice 1d4} to the first damage roll you make. This extra damage increases to {@dice 2d4} at character level 9, and to {@dice 4d4} at character level 16.

entries.name: Resilient
entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an amount equal to your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an additional 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

name: Sangromantic Initiate
entries: You have become adept enough with weaving blood magic to mitigate some of the harm of Sangromancy. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Blood Magic
entries: Choose a {@filter Sangromancy spell|spells|subschool=sangromancy} from any spell list of a level for which you have spell slots. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slot you have.

entries.name: Sanguine Potency
entries: You have a pool of two d12s that you can expend instead of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} when you cast {@filter Sangromancy spells|spells|subschool=sangromancy}. Your pool regains all expended dice when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Shadowsteel Adept
entries: You have learned to tap into the dangerous but powerful art of Shadowsteel casting. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Curse Caster
entries: You always have {@filter Shadowsteel curses|spells|subschool=shadowsteel curse} prepared, and you can cast them with any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Shadowsteel's Bite
entries: While holding your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24}, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your spells.

entries.name: Shadowsteel Weapon
entries: If your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24} is also a weapon, that weapon has a +1 bonus to weapon attack rolls and damage rolls.

name: Shadowsteel Master
entries: Your mastery over Shadowsteel grows stronger. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Necrotic Harmony
entries: While holding your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24}, when you cast a spell that targets one or more creatures and requires an attack roll or saving throw, you can choose one target you hit or who failed the saving throw to also take {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage for each spell slot level expended to cast the spell.

entries.name: Necrotic Weapon
entries: If your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24} is also a weapon, that weapon has a +2 bonus to weapon attack rolls and damage rolls. Additionally, once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack roll using your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24}, you can cause the target to take an extra {@damage 2d8} Necrotic damage.

name: Survivor
entries: Your ability to make the best out of a bad situation has served you well. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hardy
entries: You need half the amount of food per day based on your size.

entries.name: Intuitive
entries: When you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks made when taking the {@action Study|XPHB} action.

entries.name: Shake It Off
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, your {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level, if any, decreases by 1. Additionally, when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, your {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level decreases by 2.

name: Syndicate Spy
entries: Rising in the ranks of the Ebon Syndicate has taught you the clandestine skills of spycraft, valuable in your trade as a racketeer. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Locksmith
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}. While holding {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, you can craft a key to a lock by spending 10 minutes with that lock.

entries.name: Master of Disguise
entries: You have proficiency with a {@item Disguise Kit|XPHB}. If you spend 10 minutes donning a {@item Costume|XPHB},  you decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You can't appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this benefit to become quadrupedal, for instance.

entries.name: Master Calligrapher
entries: You have proficiency with a {@item Forgery Kit|XPHB}. You aren't limited to 10 or fewer words when mimicking someone else's handwriting.

entries.name: Blending In
entries: When using the {@action Hide|XPHB} action to conceal yourself from creatures that aren't {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} to you, you need only be {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} and you may use Charisma instead of Dexterity for the check.

name: Thrown Weapon Master
entries: You excel at thrown weapons. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Multithrow
entries: After you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to make a ranged attack roll using a Simple weapon that has {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown}, you can make two additional ranged attacks using Simple weapons that have {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Quick Hands
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can retrieve and stow or wield all Simple weapons with {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} that are within 5 feet of you. You need a free hand to perform this maneuver.

entries.name: Returning
entries: Simple weapons with {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} that you are proficient with also have the {@itemMastery Returning|GrimHollowPG24} mastery property.

name: Triage Expert
entries: You are trained in dealing with injuries on the battlefield, and with the saving of lives afterward. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bedside Manner
entries: Whenever you cause a creature to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or the Blood and Bone benefit, you can roll one extra die and discard the lowest die.

entries.name: Blood and Bone
entries: Taking the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action and expending the use of a {@item Healer's Kit|XPHB} lets you heal a creature within 5 feet of you. The creature can expend and roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} and regain that number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Witch Hunter
entries: You have honed and perfected your skills fighting against spellcasters, possibly from your background hunting mages as part of the Arcanist Inquisition. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dodge Spells
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to avoid a spell that is targeting only you and doesn't create an area of effect. Make a Wisdom saving throw against the spellcaster's spell save DC. On a successful save, the creature must choose a new target or the spell is canceled. A canceled spell dissipates with no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted.

entries.name: Keep Your Enemies Close
entries: When you hit a target that can cast spells with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can reduce its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Resist Curses
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against all Shadowsteel curses, and also against spells with a duration of more than 10 minutes.

name: Gun-Mage Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with Ranged Martial weapons.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Finger Guns|ValdaGunslinger} cantrip.

entries.name: Expanded Spell List
entries: The following spells are added to your spell list: {@spell Antiballistics Field|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Ballistic Smite|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Conjure Cannonball|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Conjure Cover|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Jam Weapon|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Jethro's Instant Reload|ValdaGunslinger}, and {@spell Perforating Shot|ValdaGunslinger}.

entries.name: Spells Prepared
entries: Choose a number of spells equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} from among those in the Expanded Spell List benefit. You always have these spells prepared. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of these spells with a different spell from the Expanded Spell List.

name: Iron Hero
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Underdog's Resolve
entries: When you are attacked by a creature that has a CR higher than your character level, you gain a +2 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} for that attack.

entries.name: Vengeful Strike
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature that has reduced one of your allies to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} since the end of your last turn.

entries.name: Heroic Intervention
entries: When an enemy you can see takes a Legendary Action, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to intercede, preventing the Legendary Action from happening. You can take this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Marksman's Luck
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Flip Die
entries: Once per turn, when you roll for damage with a Ranged weapon, you can flip one of the damage dice over and use the number on the bottom. You can't use this ability on d4s. Note that for a balanced die, the top and bottom numbers add up to one more than the die's largest number.

entries.name: Enhanced Critical
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} with a Ranged weapon, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of its next turn.

name: Aberrant Spawn
entries: You were somehow mutated or created by an aberration, such as an aboleth, and you suffer from strange deformities as a result. Due to these changes, you have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Aberrant Mind
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself and against any effect that would sense your emotions or read your thoughts.

entries.name: Psychic Resistance
entries: You have resistance to psychic damage.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: At least one of your limbs is muscular, rubbery, and pliant, acting as a tentacle that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

name: Aquanaut
entries: One of your parents is a merfolk, or you are distantly descended from the Elemental Plane of Water; consequently, you have aquatic features like gills, webbed fingers and toes, and fishlike scales, which grant you the following racial traits:

entries.name: Aquatic
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Finned
entries: You have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

name: Arachne
entries: Much like drow, humans can be corrupted by the magic of the drow goddess, becoming arachne—humans with eight eyes and coarse, black hair. Sometimes these humans are the offspring of driders or drow priestesses, while other times they bear the marks of a ritual sacrifice gone terribly awry.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 120 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Spider Magic
entries: You know the {@spell poison spray} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell bane} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell spider climb} spell with this trait. Once you cast {@spell bane} or spider climb with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

name: Arcane Preparation

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation; Spellcasting feature from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard class

entries: Instead of preparing spells normally, you fix each spell slot precisely in your mind, in the manner of wizards long past. When you would prepare spells when you finish a long rest, you record which spell you will use with each of your spell slots, picking from among the spells you could cast using it. These spell slots can't be expended for any purpose other than casting their assigned spells, but can be recovered and used to cast any spell. Additionally, you gain a bonus spell slot of each level for which you have spell slots, to which you do not assign a particular spell and can cast normally.

For example, a 3rd level wizard has four 1st-level spell slots and two 2nd-level spell slots. Using this feat, the wizard must assign each spell slot to a spell; for example, three 1st-level {@spell magic missile|PHB|magic missiles}, one 1st-level {@spell sleep}, one 2nd-level {@spell scorching ray}, and one 2nd-level {@spell mirror image}. The wizard also has one bonus 1st-level spell slot and one bonus 2nd-level spell slot, through which they can cast any spell they have recorded in their spellbook.

name: Battle Adept
entries: Intensive training and combat experience have allowed you to master special combat maneuvers. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain one battle die, which is a d6. This die is added to any battle dice you have from another source. A battle die is expended when you use it. You regain all of your expended battle dice when you finish a short or long rest, or when you roll initiative.

You learn {@filter two maneuvers of your choice from among those available to the Captain class or those available to the Grey Watchman subclass of the warden class.|optionalfeatures|feature type=mv:gw} You use your battle dice to fuel these maneuvers. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

name: Beastman
entries: With a short tail, coarse fur covering your face, and long teeth and claws, you appear more like a ferocious beast than a man. Perhaps your parentage includes a werecreature or an intelligent beast, granting you the following racial traits:

entries.name: Claws
entries: You have sharp claws that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to smell.

name: Bounty Hunter
entries: When there's a price on someone's head, you aim to collect. You gain the following benefits:

items: You perfectly remember the name and face of every person you've ever met.

You can use your action to mark a creature you can see within 120 feet of you for 1 hour. You have advantage on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks you make to find the marked creature. Additionally, as long as the creature is marked, you can discern whether or not the creature has passed through a location. You can have only one creature marked at a time.
Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with any attack you make or spell that you cast, you can choose to knock the creature out instead of killing it.

name: Cantrip Specialist
entries: Well practiced in fundamental spellcasting, you learn two Warmage tricks from among the following: {@optfeature Blasting Cantrip|VSS}, {@optfeature Corrosive Cantrip|VSS}, {@optfeature Draining Cantrip|VSS}, {@optfeature Explosive Cantrip|VSS}, {@optfeature Icy Cantrip|VSS}, {@optfeature Severe Cantrip|VSS}, {@optfeature Silent Cantrip|VSS}, and {@optfeature Static Cantrip|VSS}. Your cantrips count as warmage cantrips for the purposes of these tricks, and your character level counts as your warmage level, where applicable.

name: Child

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: You are an adolescent, someone who has absolutely no place in the dangerous adventuring life. Perhaps you are destined to change the world and your destiny will not wait for maturity, or perhaps you have thrown your lot in with an adventuring party who has promised to keep you safe from harm. Somehow, you are at the precipice of adventure, and have the following traits:

items: Your size is Small, even if your race is normally Medium.
You have two fewer skill proficiencies than other characters of the same class.
Your Strength and Constitution scores have a maximum of 16, instead of 20.
You gain proficiency in two saving throws of your choice.

name: Chronomancy Initiate
entries: Having unraveled the secrets of time magic, chronomancy, you have learned to pull seconds apart, reorder them, and reap minutes as a reward. You gain the following benefits:

items: All spells with the chronomancy tag are added to your class's spell list, if they are a level for which your class gets spell slots. Use your spellcasting ability for these spells.
You learn the {@spell moment to think|VSS} cantrip, which doesn't count against your total number of cantrips known.

You learn four spells of your choice that you cast with the chronomancy tag. If you prepare spells, these spells are always prepared for you and don't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you are a wizard, they are added to your spellbook instantly at no cost. If you learn spells, these spells do not count against your total number of spells known. When you gain a level in your spellcasting class, you can replace one of these spells with another spell with the chronomancy tag for which you have spell slots.

name: Dilettante
entries: With a few minutes of preparation, a bit of improvisation, and some talent, you can appear proficient in just about anything. When you finish a long rest, you can spend 10 minutes practicing with a {@filter simple|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=simple weapon} or {@filter martial|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon} weapon, skill, or {@filter tool|items|source=phb|type=tools}, or in the use of a {@filter cantrip|spells|level=0|class=Wizard} from the wizard spell list. You gain proficiency with that weapon, skill, or tool, or you learn that cantrip and can cast it using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability until you finish a long rest.

name: Diminutive

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation; Medium size

entries: You were born much smaller than others of your race, or simply never grew to full stature. You are Small instead of Medium. Additionally, suffer no penalty for squeezing into a space that is only large enough for a Tiny creature.

name: Downcaster
entries: Thanks to study or deep introspection, you have achieved a firm grasp on spellcasting fundamentals, granting you the following benefits:

items: If you learn spells, you learn 4 {@filter spells of your choice of 3rd level or lower|spells|level=1;2;3} from your class's spell list, which don't count against your total number of spells known. These spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

You can use your action to divide a spell slot of 5th level or lower into two or more lower-level spell slots whose combined level is equal to or less than the original slot's level. Any spell slot you create with this feat vanishes when you recover spell slots after a short or long rest.

name: Dual-Soul

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: Two souls occupy your body, vying for influence and time in control. You maintain two different sets of personality traits, ideals, bonds, and flaws. Your souls have different names. Your souls communicate telepathically with one another, but only one soul can be in control of your body at a time. The soul that is not in control of your body can see through your eyes and hear through your ears.
When you finish a long rest, roll a {@dice d20}. On an odd roll, the soul in control of your body switches.

The two souls within you have different backgrounds, which include different skill and tool proficiencies, as well as different languages. You only have proficiency in these skills and tools, and can only speak languages acquired from a soul's background while it is in control of your body.

name: Early Riser
entries: By following a strict routine, you've become accustomed to resting less than others. You gain the full benefit of taking a long rest in only 4 hours, and you gain the full benefit of taking a short rest in only 30 minutes. Additionally, you regain all your expended Hit Dice, rather than half of them, when you finish a long rest.

name: Elderly

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: Old age catches us all in the end, and you feel this most keenly in your aching joints as you enter your twilight years. However, you're not done with a life of adventure. Perhaps dungeon delving has been on your bucket list for decades, and you never got around to it, or perhaps you're an mercenary that has been taking contracts for longer than your contemporaries have been alive and you have no plans to stop now. Choose or roll for any number of benefits from the following table (even none) and an equal number of drawbacks.

rows: It's hard to understate your experience. You gain proficiency in the {@skill History} skill or the {@skill Insight} skill.
You've learned several trades in your life. You gain proficiency in two sets of {@item artisan's tools|PHB} of your choice
Your priorities have become crystal clear. You can always add your proficiency bonus to saving throws against being {@condition charmed}.
You have a bad back. Your lifting and carrying capacity is halved.
You have become forgetful. When you roll a 13 on the d20 for an Intelligence check, treat the d20 roll as a 1.
You have poor eyesight, which gives you disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

name: Exotic Mastery
entries: You have trained in the use of unorthodox types of weapons and armor of irregular design. As such, you gain proficiency with exotic armor and four exotic weapons of your choice.

name: Favorite Spell

prerequisite.other: The ability to cast at least one spell, spellcasting ability of 15 or higher

entries: You are so familiar with a mastered spell that you can cast it effortlessly and with aplomb. Choose a spell you can cast of 5th level or lower to be your favorite spell. You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different favorite spell each time. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you cast your favorite spell, you can imbue it with a harmless but impressive visual effect of your choice, such as a shower of sparks or a flurry of illusory doves.
When you cast your favorite spell using a spell slot, you can treat it as if you cast it using a spell slot of one level higher, up to a maximum of 9th level.
Your favorite spell can't be counterspelled.
You can cast your favorite spell once at its lowest level without using a spell slot. Once you use this ability, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Fickle Fortune
entries: Record whenever you roll a 10 or lower on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. If you roll 10 or lower three or more times consecutively, you can immediately change the d20 roll to a 20. If this was an attack roll, it doesn't score a critical hit.

name: Firebrand
entries: Born, imbued with, or later marked by the powers of Elemental Fire, these near-humans have an affinity for fire magic. Their heritage makes them dangerous adversaries in combat, as does the volatile nature of their innate powers. Firebrands are human in shape, but have deep red skin and flames behind their eyes. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Fire Resistance
entries: You have resistance to fire damage.

entries.name: Flame Magic
entries: You know the {@spell produce flame} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell burning hands} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell flaming sphere} spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast {@spell burning hands} or flaming sphere with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

name: Gambler
entries: Always keen for probabilities and risk, you often trust your safety and fortune to the hands of fate. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in all {@item gaming set|PHB|gaming sets} and have advantage on ability checks you make for games of chance.

Once on each of your turns, before you roll damage, you can place stakes on the roll. Choose less than the average, or higher than or equal to the average. If you choose correctly, you can add one extra die of damage to the roll. If you choose incorrectly, you must remove the damage die with the highest number.

name: Greenskin
entries: Your people metabolize by basking in the sunlight. Aided by your tough, photosynthetic skin, you gain the following racial traits:

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: Your skin acts as a tough natural armor. When you aren't wearing armor, your base AC equals 12 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

entries.name: Photosynthetic Resilience
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition poisoned} condition on yourself. You also have resistance to poison damage.

name: Grendel
entries: The children of goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears with humans are known as grendels. Despite their varied heritage, grendels don't quite resemble either of their parents, with green or orange-tanned skin, coarse hair, and three knuckles on each finger.

entries.name: Size
entries: Unlike other humans, you are Medium or Small, depending on your heritage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself.

entries.name: Grendel Ambition
entries: On your first turn in combat, you can add your proficiency bonus to your attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

name: Grue
entries: One of your parents was a creature of darkness, such as a shadow or a native of the Plane of Shadow. Grues, such as yourself, have blackened skin and cast a shadow in all directions, even when directly in light. In shadows, you are nearly {@condition invisible}. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Covert
entries: When you are hidden and a creature discovers you with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you can reattempt your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to hide. On a success, you silently reposition yourself and the creature doesn't notice you.
Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Hexer
entries: You learn {@filter two hexes|optionalfeatures|feature type=Hex} of your choice from among those available to the witch class, and gain the {@classFeature Cackle|Witch|VSS} feature from the witch class. Use your Charisma when determining the attack rolls and saving throws of these hexes.

name: Homebrewer
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB} if you don't already have it. Using a set of {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB} over the course of 10 minutes, you can brew potions. You gain a number of reagent dice equal to your proficiency bonus and can expend them to brew any potions available to an alchemist of 3rd level. These potions retain potency for 24 hours, after which they become inert. If you have the {@classFeature Reagent|Alchemist|VSS|3} feature from the alchemist class, you can also use these reagent dice to add additional damage to a bomb's damage roll.

name: Hunted

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: You are pursued by those who would kill you on sight or drag you to an ill-fated end. Perhaps you are fleeing the consequences of a terrible crime, or your name is on the lips of an underworld kingpin. The constant paranoia grants you a +5 bonus to your passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score and allows you to instantly awaken whenever a creature moves within 30 feet of you. However, you rarely sleep soundly. Roll a d20 whenever you take a long rest; on a 1, you instead only gain the benefits of a short rest.
If you are confident that you are permanently freed of your pursuers, such as if you escape to another plane of existence or watch your hunter die, you lose this feat.

name: Immortal
entries: According to legend, a human can achieve immortality by replacing their heart with a mote of celestial radiance. The secret to immortality, including the elixirs and rituals needed to achieve it, is protected by a small, clandestine sect of immortal mystics, each of who only know one component of the process. There are perhaps only a dozen true immortals in the world, but as many as hundreds if every tale can be believed.

entries.name: Ageless
entries: You don't age, can't be aged magically, and suffer none of the frailty of old age. You can't die of old age.

entries.name: Immortal Resilience
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end diseases and the {@condition poisoned} condition yourself. You also have resistance to poison damage.

name: Impaired Vision

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: Due to injury, illness, or incident of birth, you are unable to see as others can. Instead, you rely on a highly trained sense of hearing, and on aids like white canes to navigate. Your actual condition might range from total blindness to varying types of low vision, which grants you the following traits:

items: You have the {@condition blinded} condition. However, attack rolls do not have advantage against you due to this condition.

You have {@sense blindsight} with a range of 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind {@quickref cover||3||total cover}. Moreover, you can see an invisible creature within that range, unless the creature successfully hides from you.

You can cast spells that require you to see a target or area, provided that the target or part of the area is within 30 feet, you have a direct line of sight to the target or area, and you can hear the target if it is a creature. If the target or area is further than 30 feet from you, you can make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, you cast the spell normally. On a failure, the spell fails and has no effect.
You are immune to spells and effects, such as a medusa's Petrifying Gaze, that require you to see.

entries: If your visual impairment is ever remedied, such as through the use of a {@spell regenerate} spell, you lose the benefits of this feat. The GM should discuss with you whether or not removing your impairment is appropriate for your character—it is always a possibility, but never a requirement.

name: Insectoid
entries: Insectoids bear one or two insectlike features, such as prominent compound eyes or chitinous plates, but almost always have a pair of sensitive antennae atop their heads.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries: Due to your antennae, you have {@sense blindsight} with a range of 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind {@quickref cover||3||total cover}, even if you're {@condition blinded} or in darkness. Moreover, you can see an {@condition invisible} creature within that range, unless the creature successfully hides from you.

entries.name: Regenerative
entries: If any part of your body is amputated, but its amputation doesn't kill you, you can fully regrow that part of your body in 24 hours.

name: Jinxed

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: You were born under an unfortunate star, or were afflicted with a hex that has permanently damaged your luck. Choose a number from 2 to 19. Whenever you roll that number on an ability check or attack roll, the d20 roll becomes a 1. Additionally, when a creature rolls that number on an attack or a contested ability check against you, the d20 roll becomes a 1.

name: Lower Limb Disability

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: Due to injury, illness, or incident of birth, you are unable to walk as others do and must rely on some sort of aid for mobility. The cause might include paralysis, amputation of the leg or foot (congenital or acquired), chronic pain, muscular dystrophy, conditions which affect your respiration or balance, or a host of other factors. Because of this, you possess the following traits:

items: You rely on some sort of aid to stand and move. This can include, but is not limited to, crutches, a wheelchair or similar wheeled contraption, or a mechanical or magical apparatus that helps support your weight. Work with the GM to decide which sort of aid works best in the campaign world.
You can't take the {@action Dash} action on {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to knock you {@condition prone} or move you against your will.

entries: If your mobility disability is ever remedied, such as through the use of a {@spell regenerate} spell, you lose the benefits of this feat. The GM should discuss with you whether or not removing your impairment is appropriate for your character—it is always a possibility, but never a requirement.

name: Master Thrower
entries: You are an expert in using thrown weapons. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon. You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack, unless that modifier is negative.
When you make a ranged weapon attack, you can draw the weapon as part of the attack. You can draw any number of weapons in this fashion each round.
The short and long ranges of your thrown weapons double.

name: Mul
entries: One of your parents was a human and the other was a dwarf. Such a pairing is unlikely to have produced offspring, but you have defied the odds to join the ranks of the sturdy and resilient muls. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Armor Acclimation
entries: Your speed is not reduced by wearing heavy armor and you never have disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks as a result of wearing heavy armor.

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

name: Ogre-Blooded
entries: Your coarse features and monstrous build betray that one of your parents is an ogre. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Monstrous Strength
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Athletics} skill. Additionally, when you make a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, you can treat the result as a 10, or your level plus your Strength modifier, whichever is higher.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

name: Owlbearman
entries: You are a hulking thing of feathers, flesh, and fur; half-man, half-bear, and half-owl. None can say for sure what you are, other than the result of some mad wizard meddling in the gods' domain. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Beak
entries: You have a long, hooked beak that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Owlbear Wrestling
entries: You can attempt to {@action grapple} creatures two size categories larger than yourself, and you have advantage on {@action grapple||grappling} checks you make on your turn against creatures that are at least one size category smaller than you.

name: Porterling
entries: You are a porterling, parented both by a human and either a gnome or a halfling. You stand about as tall as a dwarf, but are far leaner—and if fathered by a gnome, also somewhat top-heavy. Though they are often confused for dwarves, porterlings can only rarely grow large or thick beards. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Flexible
entries: You have advantage on checks you make to {@action escape a grapple||escape grapple} or to slip bindings.

entries.name: Springheel Leap
entries: Whenever you make a long jump or a high jump, you can roll a {@dice d8} and add the number rolled to the number of feet you cover, even when making a standing jump. This extra distance costs movement as normal.

entries.name: Squeeze
entries: You suffer no penalty for squeezing into a space that is only large enough for a creature that is one size smaller than you.

name: Precognitive
entries: You sometimes feel impressions of events an instant before they happen. When you begin your turn, you can choose to roll a {@dice d20} and record the number rolled. The next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw you make before the end of your turn is replaced with this roll. You can use this ability three times and regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Prophesied

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: Your future—or at least a moment of it—has been precisely foretold. Perhaps a fortune-teller saw into your future and told you the exact moment of your death, or maybe you were born in accordance with a great prophecy that will unveil itself throughout your life. Choose the prophecy that has been made of your future and share it with the GM. If or when this prophecy comes true, you do not roll attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws for the duration of the prophesied events, as they have already been fixed; the GM decides the results of your rolls instead.

name: Proto-Man
entries: You come from a place of massive flora and ancient creatures; your people are hearty and robust, much like very early humans. You gain the following racial traits:

entries.name: Brave
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition frightened} condition on yourself.

entries.name: Primal Recovery
entries: When you take a short rest, you can automatically regain 1 hit die and can choose to spend it immediately. Once you use this trait, you can't use this trait again until you finish a long rest.

name: Psionic
entries: Most humans possess some dull psionic potential, but those who unlock their psionic spark transcend their peers. Sometimes, these humans are indistinguishable from ordinary folks, but other times their psionic awakening leaves a tell-tale mark: stark white hair, glowing pupils, or hair and clothing that float and drift around them.

entries.name: Empathy
entries: You can use your action to probe the surface level of a creature's emotions. You must be able to see the creature and it must be within 30 feet and have an Intelligence of 3 or higher. You learn the creature's emotional state and, at the GM's discretion, one of the creature's Bonds.

entries.name: Psionics
entries: You know the {@spell mage hand} cantrip, and the hand is {@condition invisible} when you cast the cantrip with this trait.

Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell unseen servant} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell levitate} spell with this trait. Once you cast {@spell unseen servant} or levitate with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

name: Reptiloid
entries: You bear the abrasive skin, slitted eyes, and split tongue of a reptile—perhaps due to a dragonborn or kobold parent—which grant you the following racial traits:

entries.name: Acid Spit
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with a lob of acid from your mouth. This is a special ranged attack with a range of 30 feet. You are proficient with it, and you add your Dexterity modifier to its attack and damage rolls. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d10} acid damage. This damage increases by {@dice 1d10} when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d10}), 11th level ({@dice 3d10}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d10}).
You can use your Acid Spit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Roguean
entries: You hail from an icy, desolate land, prone to dramatic swings in temperature. Surviving the interminable harshness of your home gives you the following racial traits:

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Cold Resistance
entries: You have resistance to cold damage.

entries.name: Extremophile
entries: You can tolerate temperatures as low as -100 degrees Fahrenheit and as high as 300 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Secret

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: When you gain this feat, choose one falsehood about yourself that you practice until you can recite it perfectly. This falsehood can be a single lie or an entire false history. You never need to make a {@skill Deception} check for this falsehood.

name: Showman
entries: Presentation is at least as important as being effective, if not more so. After all, there is little reason to do something unless it looks impressive. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it

If there is a non-combative audience watching you fight, once per turn, you can gain a bonus to an ability check or attack roll equal to the number of people in the audience, up to a maximum of your Charisma modifier. You can use this ability three times, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Soul Twin

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: You were born as a pair of soul twins, identical twins that share a single soul and act as an extension of one another. These twins function as a single character with two bodies, which you control.

entries.name: Actions
entries: Your twins share a single action, bonus action, and reaction between them, each of which can be taken only once by one of the twins on your turn. If you take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Dodge}, {@action Help}, {@action Hide}, {@action Ready}, or {@action Search} actions, both twins perform the action and gain its benefits.

entries.name: Attacks
entries: If you take the {@action Attack} action to attack with one twin, the other twin can attack as a bonus action. You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack, unless that modifier is negative. If you're able to make multiple attacks, you can divide these attacks between the twins.

entries.name: Hit Points
entries: Soul twins have separate hit points, which are divided between them. At 1st level, each twin has the hit points of a character of the same class. At higher levels, each soul twin's hit point maximum increases by your Constitution modifier + half a roll of the class's Hit Die (rounded up). If you use the average value instead of rolling the Hit Die, each twin gains 2 for a d6 class, 3 for a d8 class, 3 for a d10 class, 4 for a d12 class.
When you spend Hit Dice following a short rest, you must spend the dice separately on each twin.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: A pair of soul twins can only concentrate on one spell at a time. However, only one of the twins needs to concentrate on a spell to maintain it. When you cast a spell which requires concentration, you choose which twin is concentrating on it.
When casting a spell, either twin can provide the spell components, and the spell can originate from the twin of your choice.

entries.name: Magical Effects
entries: If a spell or magical ability affects one soul twin, it affects them both, unless that spell or ability affects hit points, or if the two twins are further than 100 feet apart. In either case, it affects each twin separately.

entries.name: Conditions
entries: A condition, such as being {@condition poisoned} or {@condition grappled}, affects only one twin, even if imposed by a spell.

entries.name: Death
entries: When a soul twin is reduced to 0 hit points and begins to make death saving throws, the other twin becomes {@condition incapacitated} and its speed is halved. If a soul twin dies, the other twin quickly begins to deteriorate, and perishes 24 hours later if their partner doesn't return to life.

entries.name: Empathic Link
entries: As long as both twins are on the same plane, they can empathetically sense the other's emotional state. Each twin knows when the other takes damage.

entries.name: Soul Twins
entries: The Soul Twins feat is an advanced option that shouldn't be taken by new players or those that routinely control other creatures, such as captains and necromancers. If it is unclear how a spell or effect would affect the soul twins, the GM adjudicates the outcome. A good rule of thumb is that if it heals, harms, or grabs a twin, it affects only one; if it charms, curses, enchants, or protects a twin, it affects both.

name: Spellblade
entries: You've learned to meld your strikes with sparks of arcane magic, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with one {@filter martial melee weapon|items|type=melee weapon;martial weapon|category=} of your choice.
When you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage with a melee weapon, you can change the damage to your choice of acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage.

You learn two cantrips of your choice from among the following: {@spell arc blade|VSS}, {@spell burning blade|VSS}, {@spell caustic blade|VSS}, and {@spell frigid blade|VSS}. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
